common.disclaimer: This is a learning exercise. It is not an official driving test and does not replace instruction with a driving instructor.

stop-and-check.title: Stop and check
stop-and-check.goal: Approach the STOP sign, stop before the line, and proceed only when it is safe.
stop-and-check.briefing: Slow down. Stop completely before the line. Check traffic and proceed when the way is clear.

checklist.proceededWhenClear: Proceeded when the way was clear

stop-and-check.retryGuidance: Try again. Stop, check, and proceed only when it is safe.

practice.title: Practice-area exercises
practice.disclaimer: This is a learning exercise. It is not an official driving test and does not replace instruction with a driving instructor.

moving-off.title: Moving off and stopping
moving-off.briefing: Move off. Stay in the middle of the lane and stop before the line.

reversing.title: Reversing
reversing.briefing: Select reverse while stopped. Reverse along the middle of the lane and stop before the line.

u-turn.title: U-turn
u-turn.briefing: Turn the car around inside the marked area. Use no more than three maneuvers and stay within the boundaries.

checklist.maxThreeManeuvers: Used no more than three maneuvers

parallel-parking.title: Reverse parallel parking
parallel-parking.briefing: Reverse park beside the edge of the road. Enter the marked space without touching its boundaries.

hill-start.title: Hill start
hill-start.briefing: Stop on the incline and apply the parking brake. Then move off without rolling backward.
